arguments.sql:
SELECT s.publisher_id, quote(p.publisher_name) AS stored_name, COUNT(*) AS qualifying_heroes
FROM main.superhero AS s
LEFT JOIN main.publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE s.height_cm > 200
GROUP BY s.publisher_id, p.publisher_name
ORDER BY s.publisher_id
